Content.SourceString: 招财宝 你还在外边吗
Content.LocalizedString: Precious, are you still out there?
I am what's up?
I'm at Eibon.
So dedicated
Daff isn't back yet,
Outside… who look after her

Content.SourceString: 、、虽然我很放心她，但也不是很放心
Content.LocalizedString: …I trust her but I am worried

Content.SourceString: 怎么感觉店长说的话迷迷糊糊的……
Content.LocalizedString: Why are you speaking like this…
Because I am sleepy,

Content.SourceString: 解酒药呢、哦小水仙去买了
Content.LocalizedString: The hangover medicine… oh, Daff went to buy some

Content.SourceString: 还没回来吗，，她这几天训练累...efqwwrg22
Content.LocalizedString: She's not back yet? She's been so tired from training these past efqwwrg22
Yeah.
Findkhdflk.qnioq2p2^…
…Sleep well, Boss…
…Sleep well, Boss…

Content.SourceString: 我的招财宝，现在有空来一趟纳库佩达公园吗？
Content.LocalizedString: My Precious, do you have time to come to Nacupeda Park?

Content.SourceString: 有空，但我想先问问……突然去那边是要做什么？
Content.LocalizedString: I'm free, but what's with the sudden invitation?

Content.SourceString: 我发现了一个千载难逢的投资机会，成本低、收益高，快来帮我撑个场子！
Content.LocalizedString: I've found a once-in-a-lifetime investment opportunity! Low cost, high returns! Come over and help me make an impression!
What opportunity?

Content.SourceString: 你来了就知道了，过了这村就没这店了，快来快来！
Content.LocalizedString: You'll find out when you get here! Once in a lifetime! Hurry up!

Content.SourceString: 就在纳库佩达那水池子边上~
Content.LocalizedString: Right by that pool in Nacupeda Park!
I'm on my way.
I'm on my way.
Hello?
Hello?

Content.SourceString: 太好了，联系上了。首先解释一下，我不是这部手机的主人。
Content.LocalizedString: Great, we've connected. First, let me clarify. I'm not the owner of this phone.

Content.SourceString: 看到她对你的备注是「招财宝」，所以感觉你应该和她关系比较好，所以试着来联系你。
Content.LocalizedString: I saw she has you saved as "Precious" in her contacts, which made me think you must be close to her, so I tried reaching out to you.

Content.SourceString: 之前联系了「小水仙」，一直没等到回复……
Content.LocalizedString: I tried contacting "Daff" earlier, but never got a reply…

Content.SourceString: 你是她的家属或是朋友吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Are you a relative or friend of hers?
I'm her friend. What's wrong?

Content.SourceString: 有点神志不清，应该是喝醉了。我们在未闻浦的火车站台上看到她，那时候她正想往水里跳。
Content.LocalizedString: She's disoriented. Probably drunk. We found her at the Unheard Shores train platform when she was about to jump into the water.

Content.SourceString: 看她站不稳的样子，要是下了水会很危险。
Content.LocalizedString: She could barely stand upright. It would've been extremely dangerous if she'd fallen into the water.

Content.SourceString: 我们先在这看住她，就麻烦你跑一趟来把人带回去了。
Content.LocalizedString: We'll keep an eye on her here, so if you could come pick her up and take her home, that would be a big help.

Content.SourceString: 我马上过来，麻烦你们了。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll be right there. Thank you for your help.

Content.SourceString: 我马上过来，麻烦你们了。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll be right there. Thank you for your help.
Sigh…
headache.jpg
What happened, Boss?

Content.SourceString: 这个月的房租、水电费、燃气费，七七八八扣掉
Content.LocalizedString: This month's rent, electricity, gas bills, and all sorts of other expenses…
There's barely any money left again!!

Content.SourceString: 市民生活成本那么大，海特洛在搞什么？！
Content.LocalizedString: The cost of living is so high, Hethereau is sick!
angry.jpg

Content.SourceString: 别生气。伊波恩再多接些委托，一定能把钱赚回来的！
Content.LocalizedString: Don't be upset. If Eibon takes on more commissions, we'll definitely earn the money back!

Content.SourceString: 奇怪，最近店里生意看着还行啊。
Content.LocalizedString: That's strange, the shop's business has been looking pretty good lately.

Content.SourceString: 不过……最近店里生意看着还行啊。
Content.LocalizedString: But… the shop's business has been looking pretty good lately.

Content.SourceString: 花销这么多会不会是其他原因？
Content.LocalizedString: Could the high expenses be due to other reasons?
guilty.jpg

Content.SourceString: 这个月买了太多酒的缘故？
Content.LocalizedString: Is it because you bought too much alcohol this month?

Content.SourceString: 看来这个月又没少光顾地摊了？
Content.LocalizedString: Looks like you've been hitting the flea markets quite a bit this month?
Drinking too much is bad for both your health and your wallet.

Content.SourceString: 店长也是沉浸在淘宝中不知天地为何物了……
Content.LocalizedString: You've gotten so absorbed in treasure hunting that you've lost track of everything else…
Tsk! Wrong!

Content.SourceString: 只是……最近淘了不少宝贝
Content.LocalizedString: It's just… I've been picking up quite a few treasures lately.
Got a problem with that?
I wouldn't dare…
Sigh, money flows away like water…

OptionText.LocalizedString: If you want to save money…

Content.SourceString: 如果想省钱的话……我有一计。
Content.LocalizedString: If you want to save money… I have an idea.
Tell me more.

Content.SourceString: 店长你的砍价能力怎么样？
Content.LocalizedString: How are your bargaining skills?

Content.SourceString: 呵，入门必修课，不必质疑我
Content.LocalizedString: Heh, Bargaining 101. Don't question me on this.

Content.SourceString: 假设我现在是卖家，你是买家——情景再现，Action！
Content.LocalizedString: Let's say I'm the seller and you're the buyer. Scenario recreation, action!
Hey, old thing!

OptionText.LocalizedString: …Is this how you talk to people?

Content.SourceString: 等一下，怎么这样称呼卖家，会不会太不礼貌了……
Content.LocalizedString: …Is this how you talk to people? Is this how you do deals?
Ah, this lovely lady is back again.
Okay, grandpa
There's no difference at all?!
Ahem, what are you looking to find this time?

Content.SourceString: 新进的这一批里可是有硬货噢！
Content.LocalizedString: This new batch has some real quality pieces!
How much for this jade-carved teapot?

Content.SourceString: 哎唷，有眼光！这是出土万年的老古董了！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh my, you have great taste! This is a ten-thousand-year-old antique, freshly excavated!

Content.SourceString: 我们有眼缘，便宜点卖你，只要999999999999方斯！
Content.LocalizedString: We have a connection, so I'll give you a discount! 999,999,999,999 Fons only!
99 Fons. I'll take it.

Content.SourceString: 店长你这么会砍价，不应该开销大才对……
Content.LocalizedString: Boss, you're so good at bargaining… shouldn't your expenses be lower?

Content.SourceString: 这个 这个 还有这个
Content.LocalizedString: This one, this one, and this one too
This whole row
That whole area
99 Fons. Wrap them all up for me.

Content.SourceString: 以量取胜吗……我似乎知道钱都花到哪里去了。
Content.LocalizedString: Losing through sheer volume… I think I know where all your money goes now.
confused.jpg

Content.SourceString: 店长，你的快递我拿进店里了。
Content.LocalizedString: Boss, I brought your delivery into the shop.
There were several boxes, and they're really heavy!
Thank you, Precious.
Mind helping me unpack them all while you're at it?
All unpacked.

Content.SourceString: 店长你又买这么多酒啊，酒就这么好喝嘛？
Content.LocalizedString: Owner, you bought so much alcohol again. Is it really that good?
scratchinghead.jpg
What would a little brat like you know?

Content.SourceString: 我买的不是酒，是大人的人生
Content.LocalizedString: I'm not buying alcohol, I'm buying the grown-up life.
Where did that motivational fluff come from…

Content.SourceString: 虽然不太懂……但我也算是大人了。
Content.LocalizedString: I don't really get it… but I'm a grown-up too.
starstruck.jpg
Sounds impressive!

Content.SourceString: 酒这种东西啊，如何判定「好喝」的标准呢？
Content.LocalizedString: Now, when it comes to alcohol, how do you determine what makes it good?
Take beer, for instance.

Content.SourceString: 理论上要看水源、麦芽基底和酿造工艺，对吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Theoretically, you'd look at the water source, malt base, and brewing process, right?

Content.SourceString: 但每个人的味觉都不一样
Content.LocalizedString: But everyone's taste is different.

Content.SourceString: 不同的香调构建不同的风味层次
Content.LocalizedString: Different aromatic notes create different layers of flavor.

Content.SourceString: 不同的舌头对泡沫杀口感的感知程度也不一样
Content.LocalizedString: Different people also perceive carbonation and foam texture differently.
Sounds really complicated…

Content.SourceString: 在诸多不同的味觉体验下，唯一相同的只有酒精麻痹神经后的开工
Content.LocalizedString: Among all these different taste experiences, the only thing that stays the same is the euphoria you get when alcohol numbs your nerves.
Yuuu-fowww-rrrree-uhhh
Euphoria.

Content.SourceString: 那种要飞到天上去的票i跑然
Content.LocalizedString: That feeling like you're about to float up to the sky.

Content.SourceString: 什么都不需要想的畅快感！
Content.LocalizedString: That liberating feeling where you don't have to think about anything!
You meant feeling light-headed, right…

Content.SourceString: 所以，只要达成这种「快感」就能判定酒是好喝的？
Content.LocalizedString: So as long as you achieve that kind of euphoria, you can say the alcohol tastes good?

Content.SourceString: 没体验过还是很难理解呢……
Content.LocalizedString: It's hard to understand without experiencing it myself…
You catch on quick.
You're so silly!

Content.SourceString: 总之只要达成这种「快感」，这酒就算没白喝，就算好喝！
Content.LocalizedString: Anyway, as long as you achieve that kind of euphoria, the drink's worth it and tastes good!

Content.SourceString: 这是属于大人豪迈的放松
Content.LocalizedString: This is how adults boldly unwind.
Get it?
I see…

Content.SourceString: 不过 像我手上这瓶
Content.LocalizedString: But this bottle I've got here…
The pricier stuff naturally tastes better.
Hahahahaha gaha fafa!

Content.SourceString: 喝起来有股金钱味 爽！
Content.LocalizedString: It tastes like money when you drink it. So good!
searching.jpg
happy.jpg
surprised.jpg

Content.SourceString: 这混乱的错别字和表情包……
Content.LocalizedString: All these garbled typos and random characters…

Content.SourceString: 店长，你随身带着酒喝吗……
Content.LocalizedString: Owner, do you carry alcohol around with you to drink…?

Content.SourceString: 怎么？我在给你科普酒呢
Content.LocalizedString: What? I'm educating you about alcohol here.
How can I tell you about it if I don't try it myself?
Come on, say it!
I think you should try drinking some too.
My case! Drink! Drink all you want!

OptionText.LocalizedString: I take out a bottle of alcohol.

Content.LocalizedString: Ah, this bottle seems to be leaking a bit…

Content.SourceString: 可能是快递运输途中碰撞了。
Content.LocalizedString: It probably got bumped during delivery.
What?!
I'll be right back.
Take a photo for evidence

Content.SourceString: 斯特利速递这帮人必须给我赔付！！！
Content.LocalizedString: Those people at Sterry Express better compensate me for this!!!
Wow, I sobered up quick.
Precious
Have you ever thought about
Why people run out of money?
No.
What's gotten into you now, Boss?
Is the shop losing a lot of money?
worried.jpg
Not really
Alright, maybe a little
That's not the point

Content.SourceString: 重点是，你觉得该怎么判定人这辈子花钱多还是少？
Content.LocalizedString: The point is, how do you think we should judge whether someone spends a lot or a little in their lifetime?

Content.SourceString: 听起来像一个哲学问题。
Content.LocalizedString: That sounds like a philosophical question.

Content.SourceString: 没有钱的人很难答得上这么深刻的问题。
Content.LocalizedString: Someone without money can hardly answer such a profound question.

Content.SourceString: 需要辩证看待吧，花钱多少取决于这个人的财力？
Content.LocalizedString: It needs to be looked at dialectically, right? How much someone spends depends on their financial capacity?
crying.jpg
As expected of you, Precious

Content.SourceString: 在金钱这个犀利的问题上，一针见血！
Content.LocalizedString: You hit the nail on the head with that sharp question about money!

Content.SourceString: 其实你这辈子没花多少钱
Content.LocalizedString: Actually, you haven't spent that much money in your lifetime
Just because you don't have much money
So it looks like you've spent a lot
That's just how it works
…Ouch.

Content.SourceString: 我觉得自己花钱不算多
Content.LocalizedString: I don't think I spend that much money
Well…
I think so too!

Content.SourceString: 我买的都是让我心情愉悦的东西
Content.LocalizedString: Everything I buy makes me happy
On that point alone

Content.SourceString: 它们的价值就高过一切
Content.LocalizedString: Their value is worth more than anything else
So, do you save money?

Content.SourceString: 这句和上一句有什么因果关系吗？
Content.LocalizedString: What's the connection between that and what you just said?
A bit.

Content.SourceString: 赚多少花多少才是都市生存之道。
Content.LocalizedString: Spending whatever you earn is the way of urban survival.
What an awkward topic change!
thinking.jpg

Content.SourceString: 你的方斯看起来特别眼熟，好像是我的。
Content.LocalizedString: Your Fons looks really familiar. I think it might be mine.
The Hethereau city map is so long!
Boss…
Have you been short on money lately…
Nope
I'm financially free
Financial freedom in…?

Content.SourceString: 想不买什么就不买什么
Content.LocalizedString: I can choose not to buy whatever I don't want to buy
Oh my! New person, new vibes!
overjoyed.jpg
Please go easy on me from now on, Boss.
I'll work hard, Boss!

Content.SourceString: 很好很好~咱们伊波恩这回算是淘到个宝了！
Content.LocalizedString: Excellent! Eibon has really struck gold this time!
New recruit joins
Business comes knocking on our door

Content.SourceString: 新拍的全家福我也是越看越中意！
Content.LocalizedString: The more I look at our new family photo, the more I love it!

Content.SourceString: 好久没有体会过这种一整天都顺风顺水的感觉咯
Content.LocalizedString: It's been ages since I've felt like everything's going so smoothly all day long

OptionText.LocalizedString: Maybe the photo studio's technique is just really good?

Content.LocalizedString: Maybe it's just luck?

Content.SourceString: 应该是照相馆拍的技术好？
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe the photo studio's photography technique is just really good?
It's all omens, omens!
A sign of…
The turning point where this shop finally becomes profitable!

OptionText.LocalizedString: At least we made a sale
Has it been losing money for a long time?

Content.SourceString: 不过至少刚入门就做成了一桩生意……
Content.LocalizedString: But at least I made a sale right when I started…

Content.SourceString: 这家店之前莫非一直是亏损状态吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Has this shop perhaps been running at a loss this whole time?
I'm feeling confident now too!
The past doesn't matter.
What matters is the future, the future!

Content.SourceString: 伊波恩的财路今后可就要靠你了，我很期待哦！
Content.LocalizedString: Eibon's financial future is going to depend on you from now on. I'm really looking forward to it!
fantasy.jpg
Uh…

Content.SourceString: 巴克斯的口感，回味起来可真不错啊……
Content.LocalizedString: The taste of Bacchus really has a nice aftertaste when you think back on it…

Content.SourceString: 在惠比寿尝过后，不得不承认还是挺对得起它的价格
Content.LocalizedString: After trying it at Ebisu, I have to admit it's definitely worth the price.
Was that also tasting?

Content.SourceString: 那就自费买了喝吧，巴克斯。
Content.LocalizedString: Then I'll just buy some Bacchus to drink myself.

Content.SourceString: 店长那天……吨了多少瓶巴克斯啊？
Content.LocalizedString: Boss, how many bottles of Bacchus did you down that day…?
?.jpg

Content.SourceString: 可是，到头来还是没有尽兴啊
Content.LocalizedString: But in the end, I still didn't get to drink my fill.
Precious, I never noticed that about you before.
?.jpg

Content.SourceString: 我看你也挺有败家潜力的
Content.LocalizedString: I can see you've got quite the potential to be a big spender.
You still didn't?!

Content.SourceString: 以后要对你多留个心眼了
Content.LocalizedString: I'll have to keep a closer eye on you from now on.
You actually managed to stay sane through all that…

Content.SourceString: 说到底都是大酒店不让外带的问题！
Content.LocalizedString: At the end of the day, it's all because that fancy hotel won't let you take food to go!
disgusted.jpg

Content.SourceString: 确实，那么大的一个酒店，气量这么小！
Content.LocalizedString: You're right! Such a huge hotel, but they're so petty about it!

Content.SourceString: 站在酒店的立场看，这也正常吧……
Content.LocalizedString: From the hotel's perspective, that's pretty normal though…
I knew you'd get it!

Content.SourceString: 看看卡佩那装修是什么档次
Content.LocalizedString: Just look at what kind of class The Kapé's decor is

Content.SourceString: 你能想象到他们一天赚多少钱？
Content.LocalizedString: Can you imagine how much money they make in a single day?

Content.SourceString: 舍不得这几瓶巴克斯，小家败气的！
Content.LocalizedString: Can't bear to part with a few bottles of Bacchus, how stingy!

Content.SourceString: 不过，可能是因为我第一次参与……
Content.LocalizedString: Though, maybe it's because this was my first time participating…

Content.SourceString: 拍卖的部分总觉得还挺有趣
Content.LocalizedString: I somehow found the auction part pretty interesting
Well, there was a bit of a hiccup though

Content.SourceString: 反正要头疼的也不是我们
Content.LocalizedString: Well, it's not like we're the ones who'll have to deal with the headache

Content.SourceString: 归根结底，能把想要的东西赢下来，当然有趣咯
Content.LocalizedString: At the end of the day, being able to win the things you want is what makes it fun

OptionText.LocalizedString: And it's not even our own money
It's a total freebie with zero cost

Content.LocalizedString: And it's not even our own money.
It's a total freebie with zero cost.
amused.jpg
Precious, come give me a hand!
I'm on my way.
You didn't even ask what it was about?

OptionText.LocalizedString: I didn't really think about it…

Content.SourceString: 既然是店长你需要帮忙，我觉得不需要多想。
Content.LocalizedString: Since it's you who needs help, Owner, I don't think there's much to consider.
What is it?

Content.SourceString: 哈哈，不愧是我的好招财宝~不过，我还是先跟你说明一下吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Haha, that's my wonderful Precious! But I should probably explain what this is about first.

Content.SourceString: 我在咱们这儿客厅角落里翻到一张牛皮纸，上面写着「向东十步」「向西十步」之类的话。
Content.LocalizedString: I found this piece of parchment in the corner of our living room, with things like "ten steps east" and "ten steps west" written on it.

Content.SourceString: 再仔细看看，发现这其实是一张藏宝密函。
Content.LocalizedString: When I looked closer, I realized it's actually a treasure map.

Content.SourceString: 背面写着，只要你按照上面的步骤走，就能找到一箱金银财宝。
Content.LocalizedString: The back says that if you follow the steps, you'll find a treasure chest of gold and silver.

Content.SourceString: 大概是这里某一任主人写下来提醒自己的吧，看纸张成色，有些年头了。
Content.LocalizedString: Probably written by one of the previous owners here as a reminder to themselves. Judging by the paper's condition, it's been around for quite a while…

Content.SourceString: 所以，让我「搭把手」是指什么？
Content.LocalizedString: So what exactly does giving you a hand involve?

Content.SourceString: 财宝嘛，自然是埋在地底下。要开挖地面，我一个人肯定是忙不过来。
Content.LocalizedString: Well, treasure is naturally buried underground. To dig up the ground, there's no way I can handle it all by myself.

Content.SourceString: 等把那些东西挖出来，我带你去好好吃一顿~
Content.LocalizedString: Once we dig up all that stuff, I'll treat you to a really good meal!
I'll be waiting for you in the backyard.
I'll be waiting for you in the backyard.

Content.SourceString: 今日落雨庭景致甚好，酒也甚佳。
Content.LocalizedString: Raindrop Court looks lovely today, and the wine is especially excellent, too.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师如果有空，不如来陪我小酌两杯？
Content.LocalizedString: If you're free, Appraiser, why not come keep me company for a couple of drinks?

OptionText.LocalizedString: You sure know how to enjoy yourself, Boss.

Content.SourceString: 专程到落雨庭喝酒，真是好雅兴。
Content.LocalizedString: You made a special trip to Raindrop Court just for drinks? I'm impressed.

Content.SourceString: 店长稍等片刻，我一会儿就到。
Content.LocalizedString: Boss, please wait a moment. I'll be there shortly.

Content.SourceString: 店长稍等片刻，我一会儿就到。
Content.LocalizedString: Boss, please wait a moment. I'll be there shortly.

Content.SourceString: 专程到落雨庭喝酒，真是好雅兴。
Content.LocalizedString: You made a special trip to Raindrop Court just for drinks? I'm impressed.

Content.SourceString: 店长稍等片刻，我一会儿就到。
Content.LocalizedString: Boss, please wait a moment. I'll be there shortly.
What's wrong with Precious?

Content.SourceString: ……莫不是喝醉乱发的短信？你先别乱走，我来接你。
Content.LocalizedString: …Was that a drunk text? Don't go anywhere. I'm coming to get you.
Save some drinks for me too!
What's wrong with Precious?

Content.SourceString: ……莫不是喝醉乱发的短信？你先别乱走，我来接你。
Content.LocalizedString: …Was that a drunk text? Don't go anywhere. I'm coming to get you.
Save some drinks for me too!

Content.SourceString: 招财宝，我们似乎陷入了商战
Content.LocalizedString: Precious, it looks like we've gotten ourselves caught up in a business war.
What actually happened?

Content.SourceString: 昨晚有路过的人看到半角街的广告屏上出现了很没品的伊波恩广告
Content.LocalizedString: Apparently, some people passing by last night saw a really tasteless Eibon ad on Hankaku Street.

Content.SourceString: 附近还有可疑的兜帽男子出没
Content.LocalizedString: There was also a suspicious-looking hooded man seen nearby.

Content.SourceString: 这一定是竞争对手在搞鬼
Content.LocalizedString: Without a doubt, a competitor has to be behind this.

Content.SourceString: 这是不正当竞争！我一定彻查！
Content.LocalizedString: This is unfair competition! I'll get to the bottom of it!
(affirmative sticker)
